name: Dependency triage
objective: Classify dependency updates into safe patches, deferred upgrades, or human-review items with reproducible evidence.

trigger.cadence_or_event: Weekly, and on Dependabot, Renovate, or advisory-driven update PRs.

intake.selection_rule: Group updates by risk: safe patch, minor feature, major migration, security, or blocked; act automatically only on the safe group.

workspace.isolation: Clean branch or worktree per update group.

agents.responsibility: Group updates by risk, security relevance, version change, and blast radius.
Apply low-risk updates and resolve lockfile conflicts.
Run targeted tests, typechecks, builds, and package audits.
Record accepted, deferred, and human-review updates with reasons.

gates: relevant tests, typecheck, build, and audit pass
no skipped migration steps named in changelogs
diff is limited to the intended group

state.update_rule: Record processed update IDs, verification evidence, and deferral reasons after each group.

escalation.destination: Issue assigned to the repository owner with the blocked group and evidence

exit.success: Safe updates are verified and merged or review-ready, and risky updates are deferred with reasons.
exit.stop_without_success: Verification fails repeatedly or remaining updates all require human review.
